pages.text: $(thing)City Ages$() rise as if a civilization dreamed itself complete: roads, towers, stacked homes, bridges, and strange transit bones. They are magnificent, heavy things, and the ink groans under their weight.

$(thing)Biosphere Ages$() are black emptiness strung with glassy gardens. Each sphere may hold a true biome, even one born from distant mods, and with it may come the creatures, air, and habits of that place.
Neither city nor biosphere appears by accident very often. If one blooms from an unwritten chance, assume the Age is proud, strange, and not especially interested in your continued health.
